name: Cropt
tagline: An offline, voice-first crop-disease diagnosis app that alerts neighbouring farmers in one tap.
problem: Crop disease spreads faster than advice reaches smallholders with low connectivity and literacy.
solution: On-device diagnosis from a photo with spoken treatment steps, one-tap alerts to neighbours or WhatsApp groups, a multilingual agent when online and a shared outbreak dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: photograph a sick leaf offline, hear the treatment and send an alert.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Designed around low connectivity, literacy and education together.

lessons: Audio-first design reaches users text interfaces miss.
